## What changed

Describe the change in one or two sentences.

## Type

- [ ] feat: new functionality
- [ ] fix: bug fix
- [ ] docs: documentation only
- [ ] refactor: no behavior change
- [ ] test: tests only
- [ ] chore: build, CI, tooling

## Verification

- [ ] `make test` passes
- [ ] `make build` passes (ESP-IDF v6.1, target esp32s3)
- [ ] Tested on hardware (describe board and result)
- [ ] Documentation updated (English)

## Hardware notes

Board revision, wiring changes, or calibration values if relevant.

Optional. Attach a photo of the TFT for UI changes.
